title: CursorBench 3.1
summary: CursorBench 3.1 is Cursor's internal benchmark system for evaluating AI code generation capabilities, measuring their AI assistant's performance on various coding tasks and benchmarks against other AI coding tools.
problem_solved: Provides standardized metrics to objectively evaluate and compare AI coding assistant performance across different models and tasks.
why_valuable: Enables transparent comparison of AI coding tools and helps users make informed decisions about which AI coding assistant best suits their needs.
